sections.Requirement Pseudocode:
Requirement Pseudocode

Flow: Customer Login
Inputs: userId, password
Preconditions: userId and password must be provided
Steps:
    FUNCTION login(userId, password)
        IF userId EXISTS IN database AND password IS VALID THEN
            otp = generateOTP(userId)
            sendOTP(userId, otp)
            RETURN "OTP sent to registered mobile number"
        ELSE
            RETURN "Invalid credentials"
Postconditions: User receives OTP
Error Paths:
    IF userId NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN "User not found"
    IF password IS INVALID THEN
        RETURN "Incorrect password"

Flow: OTP Verification
Inputs: userId, enteredOTP
Preconditions: User must have requested OTP
Steps:
    FUNCTION verifyOTP(userId, enteredOTP)
        storedOTP = getStoredOTP(userId)
        IF enteredOTP EQUALS storedOTP THEN
            markUserAsAuthenticated(userId)
            RETURN "Login successful"
        ELSE
            RETURN "Invalid OTP"
Postconditions: User is authenticated
Error Paths:
    IF storedOTP IS NULL THEN
        RETURN "OTP not generated or expired"

Flow: Browse Product Catalog
Inputs: userId
Preconditions: User must be logged in
Steps:
    FUNCTION browseProducts(userId)
        products = fetchAvailableProducts()
        IF products IS NOT EMPTY THEN
            RETURN products
        ELSE
            RETURN "No products available"
Postconditions: User receives a list of products
Error Paths:
    IF products NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN "Error fetching products"

Flow: Add Item to Cart
Inputs: userId, productId, quantity
Preconditions: userId must be logged in, productId must exist
Steps:
    FUNCTION addToCart(userId, productId, quantity)
        IF productExists(productId) THEN
            cartItem = createCartItem(productId, quantity)
            addItemToUserCart(userId, cartItem)
            RETURN "Item added to cart"
        ELSE
            RETURN "Product not found"
Postconditions: Item is added to the user's cart
Error Paths:
    IF quantity IS LESS THAN 1 THEN
        RETURN "Invalid quantity"

Flow: Process Payment
Inputs: userId, paymentDetails
Preconditions: User must have items in the cart
Steps:
    FUNCTION processPayment(userId, paymentDetails)
        IF cartIsNotEmpty(userId) THEN
            paymentResult = initiatePayment(paymentDetails)
            IF paymentResult IS SUCCESS THEN
                clearUserCart(userId)
                RETURN "Payment successful, order placed"
            ELSE
                RETURN "Payment failed"
        ELSE
            RETURN "Cart is empty"
Postconditions: Payment is processed
Error Paths:
    IF paymentDetails ARE INVALID THEN
        RETURN "Invalid payment details"
